company_info.company_description: "If there is one thing we pride ourselves on, it’s our customer service. Installing solar is a confusing process and we like to walk our customers through it step-by-step so they don’t get overwhelmed."

reviews.review_description: I first Engaged Sunscape for Solar expansion approx 7yrs ago, Over the last 2 years i have been weighing up the installation of batteries, a special mention to Daniel, for putting up with all my questions over the 2 years. Once the rebate was announced, I booked Sunscape to re-arrange the 6.6K from 7yrs ago, and add 10.2K of solar, and a 32Kwh Sigenergy battery.  The Installation took a total of 3 days, and allthoughout the installation process the team was very professional, and kept cleaning up after themselves.  So i have no problems recommending Sunscape for any of your Solar or battery needs.
Installed without fuss and in timeframe givenVery neat installation and we had the bonus of getting inspection done on same day of final install, has been working really well from day one

Max was very competent in advising me of the options for adding a battery to my existing solar panel installation.Sam and the team were punctual, installed the battery and more panels and inverter very quickly. He was very helpful in explaining all the technical terms and in getting the whole system running.The whole team at Sunscape Solar is courteous, helpful and professional; and I will definitely be going back to them for future battery installations.Highly recommended.
The company was well organised, efficient and friendly. The installation was smooth and well done.

From the beginning till the end to have our solar installed has been a complete process. Everything was explained from quoting, office staff to installation, and all done on the day they said would. And staff on the day were so easy to speak to explain how it all worked. Well done Sunscape solar

Sunscape Solar were professional to deal with and their quote was clear and fair. The installation team were prompt, neat and polite and did a good job.Although not the cheapest quote they were local and did a good job. I am happy l went with Sunscape Solar.

I spoke to  the sales team quite a few times and they always had the answers and called back promptly if I left a message.The installers came at exactly the time I was told and the left the site clean .Communication after the install regarding connection has been done efficiently by them and we are just waiting for the electricity company to finish the meter reconfiguration.

Quoting..Challenging all four quoted where within a very small difference.Intsall......very efficient, no time wasting. ..completed within time allowed.Connection organised, awaiting energy supplier to do their part.

Quote provide was clear, provided several useful options including costs and return on investment calculations.  Site visit to double check what was quoted.Helpful advice provided on the size of system appropriate for our needs and ability to add battery in the future.After a wet weather event, reschedule install went as planned.  Installation team very professional, efficient and quality workmanship.All paperwork, inspection, approvals all seamless.A pleasure to deal with

The sales person, Daniel, was very easy to deal with and very helpful.The installation was quick, punctual, tidy and very efficient.  The workers were very polite and friendly.Everything went as planned and installers were very helpful in explaning the rest of the process, ie: the inspector and the connection to our service provider.

Happy with the quote given.   Installation was done by friendly staff.  They arrived at the time advised and ensured I understood the system before they left.    I recommend them to anyone wishing to install solar panels.

We're glad we chose Sunscape Solar. Because of their experience, all issues associated with Solar Victoria (and there were some) were pre-empted and solved. Good communication in person and via email. Installation very efficient and neat.The inverter wifi doesn't connect to our internet (NBN satellite modem with wireless router at the other end of the house) without hard wiring or additional equipment so we are doing without OK.Cost includes the powerboard upgrade.

Sunscape Solar have been incredibly helpful, supportive & professional throughout the process. I was guided for the total process. The installation team were punctual & tidied up when finished. They organised the grid connection promptly. I can highly recommendSunscape Solar.
Very professional installation. Very efficient and easy to deal with installers. We are extremely happy with every aspect of our dealings with Sunscape Solar and highly recommend them.

From the day I rang for Max to do a quote to the final flick of of the switch there wasn't a drama. Even the electrical inspector passed a random comment..  we never have problems with their installationsWe went with Sunscape on recommendation of neighbour and would have no hesitation in further recommendations

I didn't bother chasing quotes as i believe word of mouth is the best recommendation! I did however ask around of those who had solar installed and Sunscape Solar in Grantville came up "Trumps" Good enough for me!Right from my initial phone call to them, the on-site chat to the completion of works, Sunscape were simply amazing. The whole process was stress free and everyone from the office staff to the installers could not have been more helpful, friendly and professional throughout. I suppose if you did search around, maybe you would get a cheaper quote but i decided quality, integrity and reputation to be of more importance than cost.Thanks again Team!

This is the third property that we have had Solar installed. Solarscape stood out from the other experiences in all areas. The sales process was informative and there was no pressure to sign on the dotted line.The installation was seamless and the install team were such good ambassadors for the company. I have already recommended Sunscape to friends and family who are looking at a Solar installation.
I would highly recommend Sunscape Solar. They were very knowledgeable and provided efficient and friendly service.
Very smooth & easy process, great communication and helpful staff every step of the way.

The salesperson was easily the best to deal with. He explained everything I needed to know and spent a lot more time with the initial process.The installation went very smoothly although the weather was not so good. The installers were very punctual and finished the installation quite quickly.Customer service was excellent, and they arranged everything that needed to be done. Just waiting for the first energy bill to see what energy was exported to the grid.Overall, I was very happy with Sunscape Solar.

Offered a good system with future proof options for battery and expansion, using solar edge inverter.    Solar edge made good sense in managing potential shading and expansion potential.   Install team were excellent and went the extra mile to deliver a tidy outcome in a challenging house

Solarscape installed a 5.81 kw system on my property in October 2022 and from my first contact with them, including when obtaining a quote, arranging installation and all the necessary paperwork, they were excellent. The Admin staff were helpful and made the whole process easy to navigate and understand. They were very accommodating with what I wanted to do and provided answers to all my questions. They provided options and at no time did they try to oversell products. Installation occurred on the agreed date with no problems. All paperwork including warranty documents and certification of Installer etc were provided. I would highly recommend Solarscape based on my very positive experience. Thank you Solarscape.

Sunscape Solar were professional and polite right from the initial onsite inspection from Max to advice on how to get the most benefit out of the system chosen. The Sunscape Solar team arrived at the time nominated and the Installation went smoothly and I was given a basic understanding of how the system worked. All in all, could not find any fault with the whole process and would have no hesitation in recommending Sunscape Solar.
Perfect in every way from helping us understand our options, to planning, installation and follow up. Great team who took care, were attentive, highly skilled and gave a fantastic result!
They were very friendly  and organise the grid connection straight away

Sunscape Solar were excellent especially with the paperwork. I was informed of every step in the process and the service was A+++. The installation team were efficient  and a very pleasant group. No mess and the Inspector was at my address within days. All, after service promptly completed. A fantastic installer.
Sale team were excellent and installion was on time as scheduled. There was a long wait for install due to covid but could not be happier. I would recommend Sunscape Solar.

I really can't fault this process. It would great if other purchases were as efficient and clear as this. Main points to note where the great communication process from start through to finish, information of best solution on Solar Panels and Orientation and good value for money.

Daniel Ballard from sunscapesolar straightaway knew the inherant problems of  fitting solar on a tin roof of an old house. batten spacings, panel orientation and possible number of panels which could fit on the roof. All the other 4 quotes sent a google earth pic with 20 panels in a straight line across the middle. Daniel quoted on 18X370watt Jinko panels and the quote showed placement on the roof. We dicided to to pay an extra $700 and get the Fronius inverter.  The next week Daniel came out to inspect the property, meter box and appropriate place for the inverter.This all happened in mid January. The install day was fri 19th of Feb. it was a sunny day with little wind. 4 guysworked like a well oil machine thru the instal. All were happy to  give  up information on aspects of the installation thru the day. The system was switched on and final steps were taken to link the inverter to the wifi. We had the ac running and the inverter was pumping over 20 amps into the house. The saftey inspection has been booked and should happen in early March. Overall it was a great experiance getting solar and i would like to thank Solarquotes for their great solar book, which armed me with the information and knowlage to make the right descisions.
Absolutely fantastic but the system has not been installed. They have been very helpful in all areas

Great young man that came to to the quote, nothing was a bother to him, was on time and went thru everything.Installation went very well. Arrived on time and left premises clean and tidy Help set up the inverter app before leaving.Customer service I cannot fault always helpful and organised all paperwork for grid connection.Would highly recommend and have already done soHelen (Warragul)

Pre Installation and quote verification was complimented with an actual visit by the sales consultant (Daniel) to assess the property for any deviations from the initial quote to avoid any surprises. The install team lead by Sam was punctual, effective and worked safely completing the install mid afternoon as per initial estimate. All packaging and electrical waste post install was placed in bins and areas worked on inside the house cleaned. The customer service team (Wendy) provided clear stepwise instructions coordinating electrical inspection and meter reconfiguration with provider.Personally very happy with overall process.
All went well, lovely people to deal with, very happy.
Sales process was smooth, sale guys super friendly, not pushy.Installation crew were polite, friendly , tidy.Office ladies super helpful and friendlyGreat company

From the first phone call to the installation the process was effortless.Everyone was most helpful and the boys who installed the system were very polite and considerate. I would thoroughly recommend Sunscape Solar.

An excellent experience from start to finish.From the quoting process through to the installation, everyone at the company has been fantastic to deal with.Everything was always explained very well at every step and all questions answered thoroughly and promptly.Not the very cheapest quote that I got but definitely competitive and I was more than happy to pay slightly more for the local and excellent service that I received.I'm very pleased and wouldn't hesitate to recommend Sunscape Solar.

The entire process from quotation through to installation and certification / hook in to the grid was seamless and efficient.  I chose a local firm as I wanted to support locals in South Gippsland and am mindful that if there are issues, response times should be better. I also wanted a company that is owner operated with the owner actually being part of the job (which Sam was). The attention to detail with the installation is second to none. The followup customer service was prompt and simple to follow. Whilst not the cheapest, I am very satisfied with the project one gets what one pays for and there were absolutely no short cuts taken. Thanks Sunscape Solar!

Prompt quoting and telephone calls to let us know about how it all works.Installation was excellent, quick and efficient. They arrived on time, and cleaned up after themselves.Customer service was also excellent, and helped organise the grid connection after the install. Would definitely recommend them. Extremely happy with the outcome.
My dealings with Sunscape have left me extremely pleased. They are a professional crew right from first contact to installation. I recommed them highly. Always friendly, informed and punctual.

The sales & quoting process was good.The installation was as advised & punctual.Good installers who provided good education on the software for the inverter.Support re grid connection was good.Not a criticism of the installers, but the supply retailers efforts left a lot to be desired!
Could not fault Sunscape. From the quotation, after sales service, and installation. Really happy with everything and couldnâ€™t endorse them enough.

Sales/quoting for the system was straight forward with no pressure and we got the best system available.Installation was thorough and clean.The only disappointment is that we are still waiting on system inspection and grid connection after 2 weeks as inspectors haven't kept appointments / haven't contacted me to make a new appointment and generally don't seem interested in coming out to do the certification.
We felt this company was very professional, helpful and informative and always willing to answer our questions.
great company to deal with.A family owned business employing its own staff.

Approached Sunscape Electrical to have a solar system installed at my home. From the very outset the staff at the company were just fantastic.   They recommended a good quality system and the price they quoted was very competitive. Throughout the whole process, from quote to finished installation, the staff have been very friendly, efficient, punctual and very helpful. They took care of all the required paperwork and kept me informed throughout the process. The installation was carried out in a timely and efficient manner with a high standard of workmanship. They made the whole process of solar panel installation very easy. I cannot recommend them highly enough. Nik C.
Great dealings with the sale rep, will see how the installation process goes, but I'm expecting smooth process from the communications I have received to date.

Sunscape have been very professional to deal with. They were informative, dependable, punctual and efficient. The instillation was quick, painless and looks good.  We have been informed and supported through out the process. Thank you to all at Sunscape for your professionalism. I would be happy to recommend Sunscape to do an excellent job.

The service and installation from Sunscape was fantastic. They are very helpful and friendly people. On the day they took their time and were extra careful as we had to use my neighbour's garage roof to get to mine. I'm very pleased with everything.
More than happy to recommend Sunscape. Listened to my needs and advised accordingly. Customer service brilliant through every stage of the process.
Sunscape were the only company to give me a quote, I was very happy with their service and price and am looking forward to having it installed at the end of the month, Thank you Finn for your service

Out of the supplier's hands to an extent, but little told about the delay in getting the feed-in tariff set up and operating, as well as the additional charge that comes from the retailer on setting up the meter for the feed-in. Both my supplier quote visits were a little lacking on these points. Apart from that, very happy with the installation. I would recommend Sunscape Electrical. Your blurb on solar installations, and things to look out for, were very useful, particularly on panel and inverter selection. It brought me up to speed very quickly and certainly helped when talking with the suppliers at quote time as I knew at least half of what was going on. Choosing from your list of suppliers certainly eased my concerns and both of them didn't try to diddle me into something I shouldn't be paying for, and only listed quality known panel and inverter options, as per your blurb.
Very happy.
Always happy to supply me with information I requested and promptly responded to emails. I have already recommended this company to 2 other people.

We were kept informed of any changes and all the steps they needed to take to complete. We were walked through everything we needed to know about how it works. I was at work & my wife was at home, they were so friendly easy to talk to & could answer any question she had. We would highly recommended anyone to use them

Friendly and very easy to work with. Did have to wait quite a while for installation (6 weeks) but was happy to wait and I was made to feel very confident about the quality of service and standard. Looking forward to the installation.
The team at Sunscape are fantastic, stop shopping and sign up.

What i liked at the start, there was no pressure from the initial contact to when Darren came out to quote. Explained everything to me , not that i understood it all , but it was all genuine, no bulltish or outlandish claims , like i had from others in the past with hard sell.As they didn't have the panels in stock , they supplied  higher quality panels at no extra cost.Installation day, the young installers were excellent,  well presented,  well mannered , polite , it was a pleasure having them working at my house.Finn , in all a pleasurable experience,  thank you for your recommendationsRegards  David

Right from the first phone call with Daniel the sales man, to installation with Sam and his boys and contact with the office staff, I was impressed.  They were all punctual, friendly and helpful.  The installation was faultless and the quality of their work was exceptional.  They were clean, tidy and very professional. I would not hesitate recommending Sunscape Electrical to others.  It's good to see tradies that still take pride in their work.  Thank you for a stress free install.
Quality service and Installation, more than happy to recommend that you use Sunscape Electrical to purchase and install your Solar system.

i am very happy with them all ,from the sales man to the work that was done on my property..they also put in 2 new power boards and 6 electric  plugs            i also  had a dog of mine that  attack the boss and his arm was badly damaged in the attack,they have never held this against me and they payed all costs.i say this to let you the nature of this small family  company.i am well pleased Jane e Green xxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxxx

Sunscape were very professional, all my queries were answered quickly. We already had a 1kw system which was enough to light the dog house however with the add on up to 5kw we have a good sized credit which we hope will take us through the winter months.  The installation fellows were great ! And the Fronius box shows exactly the amount of power being fed back into the grid. We could not be more delighted
Everything done on time as promised. Honest discussion about the process, no pressure to buy. Good advice.
I'd like to thank you for your assistance.
The installer was excellent, took lots of time to explain everything. Installation was completed without a hitch. So far 5 stars out of 5
We haven't had the system completed yet house is still under construction.
I have already recommended Sunscape Electrical to others
Timely follow up, not pushy. Seemed to focus on results rather than making a sale.
Initially the safety switch kept tripping.  Company electrician installed a replacement.  This did not solve the problem and further repairs were undertaken.
I was happy with the provider I found through solarquotes, I would recommend this site to anyone trying to find a reputable provider to install your solar system.
review already submitted

One ran a near second. They seemed to have a broader understanding of new developments and more training for their staff. If we had purchased batteries at this time we might have gone with them.Sunscape was very responsive and based on pricing won out. There was some discussion about the lack of up to date assessments on panels-GCL vs Trina but we went with Trina based on advice from your site.
Employees showed up on time each time, the system was discussed and any questions I had were answered fully.

These guys were great from start to finish. I got recommended Sunscape through a friend and was so impressed by the friendly service and the patience and professionalism with ALL my annoying questions I didn't even bother getting quotes elsewhere.Daniel was very informative and helpful throughout the quotation process and Sam (with his team) made the installation process worry free and left my place clean and tidy. They offered ongoing support if I had any issues and I would happily recommend Sunscape to anyone.
We are waiting for the selected panels to arrive.

Daniel is a very professional sales person.  He found out what we wanted and advised us and quoted accordingly.The installation team were terrific.  They went through our wish list regarding the visual impact on our property (location on roof of panels, location of the inverter, and route for the wiring from the panels to the inverter.  They were friendly, courteous and respectful of our property.The administration team touched base with us prior to the installation which occurred within the agreed timelines and submitted the paperwork to the power company.The system has been running very efficiently for about one month.Not the cheapest quote we received but based on all aspects of our experience I have no hesitation in recommending this company.

After a long haul we finally made a decision the only thing that bothered me were the cold calls from solar companies at the same time I think I was so over the word solar by the end hahah ..We had to await my sisters answer to the 3 quotes we sent her but she agreed with us on Daniel in the end

The group as a whole were all informative, polite, reliable and approachable. They provided the options available and answered questions without trying to push one system over another. I would recommend them to other people.

Due to shading issues I was advised to install a micro inverter system. I am extremely pleased with the production output to date, although I realise that this will reduce in the winter months. Sunscape Electrical's consultant was extremely knowledgeable and not at all pushy. He was very helpful with some follow up questions that I had after the installation. The installers were professional and completed the job in under a day and left the site neat and tidy, taking away all the packaging. Sunscape Electrical organised the changeover with my electricity retailer so all I had to do was fill out a single form to organise the contract. I have already recommended Sunscape Electrical to others. In my opinion, they are a professional and trustworthy company.

Although I am extremely happy with my purchase and the service from Sunscape, it has to be said that it actually came down to a choice of one.  The other Solar supplier, East Gippsland Solar made an appointment to visit then didn't turn up!  The final supplier you sent our details to didn't even make contact.However I do reiterate I am very happy with the service, skills and kit supplied by Sunscape.
Sunscape Electrical were very easy to deal with and provided a prompt, straightforward  and easy to understand  quote.  Installation today, hoping for a great result.

Sunscape electrical was the only company out off the three quotes that not only sent a email on their line of solar power systems they rang to make a time to send out a consultant Daniel was very helpful in explaining what we should be looking for in solar power panels when we made our decision Daniel kept in contact by phone and email and said at anytime contact him to discuss anything ,Melanie from administration was great handled all the paperwork that had to be sent to our electrical company I would recommend Sunscape electrical to all my family and friends great company very happy 10 out of 10 for this company.

The Sunscape Team headed by Sam installed the 5.4kW system in a day , no fuss, no mess , very professional team , treated the property with respect , and a happy crew with lots of smiles, recommend them 110 %, Thank you

I would recomend these guys to family and friends,the installer Sam Leighton was very knowledgable thorough and efficent setting up the system and the back office support was also very good.Sam took the time to explain the setting up of the wifi and explained everything in a understandable manner.He came when he said he would which makes a nice change.

The installer was the owner of the company and turned up at the time booked, worked all day and part into dusk.   Both workers were respectful of my property. Excellent quality installation and very courteous.

Great explanations, accurate information and well priced. Flawless, timely installation. No pressure or constant hassling unlike others. Great, small, family company sourcing top products for competitive prices.

The Sunscape people that we dealt with were punctual, friendly and explained our options to our satisfaction. The installation was done in a timely manner, all rubbish from installation was removed and the ongoing procedures were explained. We were very happy with our choice and would recommend.
Excellent process and very good communication both with installation as well as all of the follow up paperwork. Very happy to recommend Sunscape Electrical

Installer was right - Ausnet will not go over 4.5 kW of solar panels - per their website - without applying for an exemption.  As it turns out I will be struggling to squeeze this much on my roof space and I believe it will be enough for our needs.

These guys are extremely thorough and obliging. I actually opted for a 3.54 kW system with 12 Trina panels and a Fronius 4kW inverter. The installers, Sam & Damien turned up on time and nothing phased them. (excuse the pun). Melanie in the office attended to the paperwork so quickly that I was taken aback, even when Origin and Ausnet had me on the meter within 7 days of installation! Shopping locally is very important to me and Sunscape did not let me down. A small business, very well run. 5 stars! Finn Peacock's site was a fabulous start for me and a mine of information. Daniel the Sunscape salesperson is excellent with no end of trouble to answer my many queries.

The team at Sunscape are fantastic, Daniel answered all of my questions, and Sam the owner and installer was excellent, on time with all the right equipment. All in all very happy with Sunscape and 3 solar Quotes. My advice to anyone looking to install solar, is do some research. Cheers Anthony. Buffalo Victoria

I had a 4.59kw solar system installed by Sunscape Electrical in December 2016. I obtained three quotes for solar and Sunscape provided a competitive price and good assistance when I was considering my options including advice on batteries and size of array. The installation was scheduled conveniently and installation performed as planned with no problems. The solar panels and inverter worked immediately and so far we have had no problems. Meter activation was not as quick as hoped due to a slow response from my energy provider but throughout Sunscape provided assistance and chased up the provider. Overall, I believe Sunscape did a good installation and offer very good customer service.
Service was good.Treated with respect.All went to plan.All rubbish taken away. No mess left.Good explanation of equipment.
So far, good but until the inverter comes in cannot comment on the system.

I was a very inquisitive client, and Sunscape were happy to follow up all my enquiries, even adjusting the size of the system to allow for the addition of wind power down the track. Through them, I investigated string systems and micro inverters, wi-fi data logging, and siting. They were very helpful in all areas. Within 2 days of my order confirmation, the system is installed (just waiting on the data logger), has been ticked off by an independent electrical inspector. He was all praise for the installer and the inverter I chose, a great positive. Today, first full day, it has produced 3 times my average daily usage.

Sunscape were great to deal with each step of the way. They were punctual, efficient and timely in their quotations and installation. Sam took the time to show me how everything worked, set up the inverter's wifi plus the app on my laptop, cleaned up all the mess, and was prompt in lodging any relevant paperwork. You can't ask for more than that! System is working great, and is perfect for our needs. I have already recommended Sunscape to family and friends.
Fantastic people to deal with.

I can't really judge value for money till have used the system for a few years.  But so far, I'm getting really good power coming out of these panels.  The pricing was very competitive.  Sunscape were also really nice to deal with.  Sam, the electrician, was considerate in rearranging his work with my kid's nap times, as to minimize disturbances.  He was very good to work with.  I would recommend this company to someone else looking to install Solar Panels.
They arrived pretty well on time took approximately six hours

Sunscape Electrical were well priced, not pushy and when they came to do the work were extremely professional. My husband is an electrician so was across what needed to be done and he found their level of workmanship exceptional. The way they performed their work was second to none. We would highly recommend them to anyone wishing to install Solar in the Gippsland region.

Sunscape Electrical are a local based company that are passionate about solar and will go out of their way to provide the best service and warranty, using the best products and at the best price. We had discussions at length about the best positioning of solar panels and also ways to utilise their power production when the sun is shining, prior to installation, to ensure that the system would be the best it could be. Well done Sunscape.

Sunscape offered the quickest response by far, knowledgeable sales person who took time to explain what and why and recommended based on what could be fitted where, current power consumption etc. The price was reasonable compared to others that I had previously looked at and the installation and follow up has been terrific.Very professional installation and layout to best fit the roof space and administration follow up to ensure we got hooked up with supplier.

Fast, efficient service and supply of information. Thorough run through of system. Very neat installation.  A customer friendly team. All working well, but haven't had an energy bill yet. Had trouble negotiating rate with Energy Australia, may change provider.
Lovely local guys who cut out the middlemen that the big companies use as salespeople. Was very competitively priced and I really like supporting smaller local businesses.

Samuel from Sunscape Electrical arrived promptly on the due date. Took only 1 day to install 12 panels and inverter. Lovely, friendly service.Melanie from Sunscape arranged connection with my electricity company,Thank you Samuel and Melanie for great service.

The house is under construction so at this stage I have ordered the system and paid a deposit. The company are very helpful and have provided advice and suggestions. The initial wiring has been undertaken and will be finalised when the house is finished. The process was undertaken in a timely, friendly and professional manner.

Although I was already reasonably familiar with Solar Panels and inverters Sunscape were very knowledgeable and gave me further good advice.  I was not treated as a dummy so when I asked detailed questions - I got detailed and proper answers.
